caption: The drawing depicts a single round metallic bowl, rendered in shades of gray, positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The bowl has a raised rim and a smooth, concave interior, with shading to indicate depth and curvature. Attached to the upper side of the bowl is an ornate, decorative handle with cut-out patterns and a rounded top, also shaded to suggest its metallic texture. Beneath the main drawing, within the same rectangular border, there is a smaller inset technical sketch of the bowl in profile. This smaller sketch includes measurements, indicating the bowl's diameter (4 7/8 inches) and height (2 inches), with other minor dimension notations. The drawing is signed in cursive with the name “Charles Cullen” at the lower right. The background is a plain, off-white or beige with slight discoloration or aging visible around the edges.
title: Pewter Porringer
